name: Undertale battle
author: Eggscantfly
description: Start an Undertale-style battle in any level of Rabbids Go Home. Press G to begin the encounter, complete with the battle intro and Spider Dance. FIGHT uses the real attack bar, and ACT, ITEM and MERCY work as menu options. The mod is written in Lua, so it can be changed without rebuilding anything. It needs your own copy of Undertale, which it reads while you play. Set the Undertale folder in config.lua, where you can also change the key, the song and the volumes.
